transcript: I picked the low-tech, small-scale as my most preferred because I think, especially coming from a crisis, consumerism and the over-consumption and taking more than is needed, greed, those kinds of things in society would be detrimental. And I think a society where you're using what you need and there is less damage to the planet and pollution and all that, I think would be very ideal. My least preferred was the AI-centered utopia. With the concerns already growing with AI, I would hate to imagine that it would be the center of our society. I think it would remove the very human aspects of life. I think if a crisis, you've just came out of a crisis, it's humans that need to fix that and adjust and work around the damage that they've caused and they've done, not AI-powered technology.
